cues.text: The dorm's front door. You come in with your bag over your shoulder.

In the lounge, the others sit on the sofas around the low table: Junpei, Yukari, Fuuka, Ken, Akihiko, Mitsuru and Shinjiro. Aigis stands behind them, with Koromaru sitting beside her. You walk over to join them.
Ken gets up and walks out of the lounge.
